name: 秦
feature: 中国首个大一统中央集权帝国，制度影响两千年。
featureEn: China's first unified centralized empire; its institutions shaped two millennia.
summary: 虽短祚却确立帝制框架，中央集权范式沿用两千年；秦亡后楚汉相争，旋由汉继统。
summaryEn: Brief yet it established the imperial framework; the centralized paradigm endured for two thousand years; after Qin fell the Chu–Han contention ensued, then Han succeeded.

emperors.noteEn: Conquered the six states and claimed the imperial title
Tyranny led to a swift fall
Reigned 46 days, surrendered to Liu Bang

文臣.noteEn: Chancellor; commanderies-counties system and unified writing
Usurped power; “pointing at a deer and calling it a horse”

武将.noteEn: Struck the Xiongnu in the north, built the Great Wall

policiesEn: Built the Great Wall and highways
Burning of books and burying of scholars
Governing by law as the teaching

政治: 首创皇帝制、三公九卿与郡县制
中央集权体制由此奠定
经济: 统一度量衡、货币与车轨
文化: 书同文，以小篆统一文字
焚书坑儒，思想文化受强管控

政治: Founded the imperial system, the Three Excellencies and Nine Ministers, and commanderies-counties
The centralized system was thereby established
经济: Unified weights, measures, coinage and axle gauges
Built highways and the Lingqu Canal; emphasized agriculture, restrained commerce
文化: Unified writing; standardized the script in small seal script
Burning books and burying scholars; thought and culture under tight control
